subject: MAP: Threshold milestones & term options for dedicated GPU pool
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: sofia@kairoanalytics.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Threshold milestones & term options for dedicated GPU pool

Hi Sofia —

Great to speak yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf) and a lightweight SOW that maps directly to milestones we discussed. High level:

- Goal: Pilot (2–4 weeks) -> Ramp (3 months) -> Production steady-state (12 month term option)
- Proposed dedicated pool: 8x A100 equivalent GPUs initially, scale to 24x at Ramp milestone
- Pricing: staged unit rates tied to MAP milestones (pilot discounted rate; ramp = list less 22%; steady = list less 15%)
- Burst clause: up to 2x capacity for 72 hours per month at pre-negotiated short-burst rate; longer bursts require 72h notice and approval
- Escrow/credits: 10% of committed spend reserved as ramp credits, redeemable if utilization < 60% after 90 days

I noted three decision points for procurement/legal: term length (12 vs 24 months), SLA credit cap, and burst overage pricing. If you can, please confirm whether Kairo prefers a 12- or 24-month commitment and share any procurement timing constraints.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review attached MAP & SOW — flag any must-haves by Wed 8/4
2) We finalize pricing table and DocuSign link — Redwood prepares final SOW for signature by Fri 8/6
3) Pilot kickoff week of 8/16 (subject to signature)

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf (application/pdf), SOW-Kairo-2027.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@kairoanalytics.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@kairoanalytics.com
Date: 2027-08-02T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Threshold milestones & term options for dedicated GPU pool

Markus, thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our side and legal: 

1) Pool sizing: our initial inference workload is bursty; can the ramp milestone be tied to observed 7-day average utilization rather than fixed date? We want the commit to scale when we see sustained demand.
2) Burst clause: the 2x/72h sounds OK for pilot, but legal wants a clear overage rate if we exceed burst credits — can you put an exact $/GPU-hour number for the short-burst rate and the long-burst (unplanned) rate?
3) Credits/escrow: curious how the 10% ramp credit interacts with early termination — is that fully refundable or applies as future credit only?

Procurement flagged that if we select 24 months we need a larger up-front discount; would Redwood be open to a tiered discount that increases at 12 and 18 months?

We'll pull numbers internally and get back on preferred term by EOD 8/4. Legal also attached a short checklist (see contracts@kairoanalytics.com) — they ask for SOC2 appendix and a sample SLA.

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of ML Ops, Kairo Analytics
sofia@kairoanalytics.com

> On Aug 1, 2027, at 9:12 AM, markus.klein@redwood.ai wrote:
> > Great to speak yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan...
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: sofia@kairoanalytics.com, contracts@kairoanalytics.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-02T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Threshold milestones & term options for dedicated GPU pool

Thanks Sofia — good questions. Quick answers inline and a couple of updates to the MAP attached (we updated pricing rows and added a utilization-based ramp trigger):

1) Pool sizing / ramp trigger: happy to make ramp conditional on a 7-day sustained utilization average > 65% or a 30-day sustained > 55% (we'll include both triggers in the MAP). This avoids a hard calendar cutoff and aligns commercial commit to real usage.

2) Burst rates (examples in updated MAP):
   - Short-burst (<=72h/month): $12 / GPU-hour (pre-negotiated reduced rate)
   - Unplanned/extended: $28 / GPU-hour after 72h or outside agreed bursts

3) Ramp credits: the 10% is issued as a credit applied to invoices over the first 3 billing cycles; if Kairo terminates early without cause the remaining unused credit converts to a one-time invoice adjustment (not refunded). We can discuss a cash refund instead if required by procurement for an additional fee.

4) Term & discounts: Redwood can structure an escalating discount schedule: 12 months = list -15%, 18 months = list -18%, 24 months = list -22% (applies to baseline committed units). We can layer limited promo credits for the pilot independent of term.

Action items I need from you by Wed 8/4: preferred term (12|18|24), preferred ramp trigger (calendar vs utilization; if utilization please confirm which of the above triggers you prefer), and any required legal addenda (SOC2 appendix is standard; we'll attach a redline-friendly version).

I've also created a HubSpot deal (HS-9847) and will follow with a draft DocuSign once we lock term/discounts.

Cheers,
Markus

--
Redwood Inference
From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: discount approval & burst pricing confirmation

Markus / Aditya — quick internal note before we send final numbers to Kairo.

1) 24-month at -22% is OK only if they commit to minimum 18k GPU-hours/month after ramp. Otherwise cap at -20%.
2) Keep the short-burst $12/GPU-hr and long-burst $28/GPU-hr as published. Finance wants a clause that limits credit exposure to 3 months of committed spend.
3) For the ramp credit refund request — reject cash refund; offer to increase credit to 12% (applied across first 3 cycles) if procurement insists on cash.

I'll join call with Kairo if they want to walk through the MAP. If we move forward, let's prepare final SOW with the utilization-driven ramp trigger and the 3-month credit exposure cap.

- Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success Operations
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@kairoanalytics.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@kairoanalytics.com
Date: 2027-08-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Threshold milestones & term options for dedicated GPU pool

Thanks everyone — internal check complete. Kairo will:
- Choose 18-month term (prefer list -18% per Markus' schedule)
- Accept utilization-driven ramp trigger (7-day avg >65%)
- Accept short-burst $12/GPU-hr and long-burst $28/GPU-hr
- Prefers credits applied to invoices (no cash refund)

Legal asked for a SOC2 appendix and sample SLA; they can accept Redwood's standard language. Please send an updated SOW and DocuSign link with the agreed terms and we'll route for signature (procurement aims to sign by Fri 8/6).

Once signed we will plan pilot kickoff the week of 8/16.

Sofia Ramirez
Head of ML Ops, Kairo Analytics
sofia@kairoanalytics.com
